title: Figures at a glance
notes: 1. * For calculation of Crime Rate of Crimes Against Women, Crimes Against SCs, Crimes Against STs, Crimes Against Children and Crimes Against Senior
Citizens, their respective population has been used instead of overall total population figures as used for other crime heads.
